title: The dell-xps-touchpad-haptics package before 1.0.0-4 for Omarchy allows local users to change ownership of a…
description: A vulnerability in the dell-xps-touchpad-haptics package before version 1.0.0-4 for Omarchy allows local users to change ownership of a root-owned file by creating a symbolic link from their own configuration file to the target file. This can lead to unauthorized modification of critical system files.
